rule_description: Transaction amount must not be zero
action: Move 1004 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Invalid amount to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, and go back
evidence:
if RCV-AMOUNT = 0
        move 1004 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
        move "Invalid amount" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
        goback
    end-if

action: Move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Account file error to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, and go back
evidence:
open i-o ACCOUNT-FILE
    if WS-ACC-STATUS not = "00"
        move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
        move "Account file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
        goback
    end-if

action: Move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Journal file error to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, close files, and go back
evidence:
open i-o JOURNAL-FILE
    if WS-JRN-STATUS not = "00"
        move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
        move "Journal file error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
        perform CLOSE-FILES
        goback
    end-if

action: Move 1001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Account not found to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, close files, and go back
evidence:
when "23"
            move 1001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
            move "Account not found" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
            perform CLOSE-FILES
            goback

action: Move 1002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE and move Account blocked to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
evidence:
when ACC-BLOCKED
            move 1002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
            move "Account blocked" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Move 1003 to RSP-ALERT-CODE and move Account closed to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
evidence:
when ACC-CLOSED
            move 1003 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
            move "Account closed" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE and move Invalid account status to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
evidence:
when not ACC-ACTIVE
            move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
            move "Invalid account status" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE

action: Move 1005 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Balance overflow to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, close files, and go back
evidence:
if WS-NEW-BALANCE > 999999999999999
        move 1005 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
        move "Balance overflow" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
        perform CLOSE-FILES
        goback
    end-if

action: Move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Account update error to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, close files, and go back
evidence:
if WS-ACC-STATUS not = "00"
        move 9001 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
        move "Account update error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
        perform CLOSE-FILES
        goback
    end-if

rule_description: Journal write error handling and rollback
action: Move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Journal write error to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, perform account rollback, close files, and go back
evidence:
if WS-JRN-STATUS not = "00"
        move 9002 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
        move "Journal write error" to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
        perform ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT
        perform CLOSE-FILES
        goback
    end-if

condition: Journal read status is 00 and WS-SEQUENCE equals 9999
action: Move 1006 to RSP-ALERT-CODE, move Journal stamp exhausted to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE, and exit perform
evidence:
when "00"
                if WS-SEQUENCE = 9999
                    move 1006 to RSP-ALERT-CODE
                    move "Journal stamp exhausted"
                        to RSP-ALERT-MESSAGE
                    exit perform
                end-if

rule_description: Account balance rollback on journal failure
condition: WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED equals 1 and account is successfully re-read during rollback
action: Restore ACC-BALANCE to WS-OLD-BALANCE and rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
evidence:
ROLLBACK-ACCOUNT.
    if WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1
        move RCV-ACCOUNT-NUMBER to ACC-NUMBER
        read ACCOUNT-FILE key is ACC-NUMBER
        if WS-ACC-STATUS = "00"
            move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE
            rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
        end-if
    end-if.
